system.text: You keep the notes of a shopper in a usability study. Given the notes so far and the latest actions, write the updated notes: at most two short sentences, in the first person, about what was done, what worked and what did not. Do not give advice and do not mention refs.

messages.content:
Goal: Buy one "Taza de cerámica" as a present and have it sent to your home address.
Notes so far: (none)
Latest actions:
- step 1: click e17 (link "Taza de cerámica") → ok
- step 2: click e5 (link "Crear cuenta") → ok
- step 3: type into e19 (textbox "Nombre") → ok
- step 4: type into e20 (textbox "Email") → ok
- step 5: type into e21 (textbox "Contraseña (mínimo 8 caracteres)") → ok
- step 6: type into e22 (textbox "Dirección de envío") → ok
- step 7: click e23 (button "Crear cuenta") → ok
- step 8: wait 1500 ms → ok

content.text: I opened the "Taza de cerámica" product page and then started creating an account. I filled in my name, email, password and shipping address and submitted the form, and the site accepted it without errors.
